wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)

# Access the sheets

    else:
        selected_date = selected_date_val

# 2. Calculate the monthly total from 'Pay Dates' sheet
# The 'Pay Dates' sheet has columns: Date, Paycheck 1, Paycheck 2
# We need to sum all paychecks for the month and year of the selected date.
target_month = selected_date.month
target_year = selected_date.year

monthly_total = 0.0

# Iterate through the 'Pay Dates' sheet starting from row 2 (skipping header)

    date_val, pc1, pc2 = row
    if date_val and isinstance(date_val, (datetime, pd.Timestamp)):

            monthly_total += (pc2 if isinstance(pc2, (int, float)) else 0)

overview_sheet['B5'] = monthly_total

# Verify the value
final_val = overview_sheet['B5'].value
